name: olive-tree-studio
description: Continue Olive Tree interior 3D projects from durable GitHub customer records without repeating confirmed design questions.

interface.longDescription: A private workflow plugin for Olive Tree Interiors. Reads the studio repository workflow and customer checkpoints before continuing design work, asks only for missing decisions, preserves verified source geometry and customer-specific pricing, and records changes for future chats. Uses available GitHub, file and browser tools; includes the established bounded Python SKP reader, not a universal converter or repository credentials.
defaultPrompt: Continue Mr. Suresh's TV unit from the studio repository. Read the customer record and status first.
Inspect my SketchUp model and ask only about missing design details, using its source colours.
